comment: Native runtime libraries linked into JIT/native builds. semanticscript reads this data — it carries no per-library knowledge in the compiler. A library is built (cached) and loaded only when a program references a runtimeBinding symbol matching one of its `provides` prefixes. R-018: link inputs are platform-scoped. Top-level `sources`/`include`/`defines`/`libs` are the cross-platform base; `platforms.<name>` (windows|linux|macos|wasi) adds host-specific entries, and `compiler.<driver>` (gnu|clang|msvc|zig) adds driver-specific overlays. The resolver `_resolve_runtime_links(library, platform)` merges base + platform + compiler WITHOUT compiling, so non-Windows builds never see Windows-only libs like ws2_32 (R-013).

libraries.name: ss_string
libraries.comment: X-200: byte-string comparison/(in)equality/find helpers (standard.string), bound via the generic runtimeBinding seam (no compiler change).

linux.comment: R-019: SQLite follows the native_sqlite CMake profile: Threads::Threads, CMAKE_DL_LIBS, and m on Linux.

macos.comment: R-019: CMAKE_DL_LIBS is empty on macOS; keep thread/math scoped here without adding Linux's -ldl.

libraries.name: ss_event
libraries.comment: APP-RUN-3 in-process event pub/sub (event.*): a stream queue + per-subscription cursor, no external deps.

libraries.name: ss_widgets
libraries.comment: APP-RUN-4 headless widget runtime (gui.*): in-memory handle stubs so the desktop app's control tree + event wiring run non-interactively. Separate ss_widget_ prefix avoids the real Win32 ss_gui_* symbols.

libraries.name: ss_libc
libraries.comment: APP-RUN-6/APP-RUN-2 libc shims (c.*) with Int64/const char* signatures so the app's declared types match exactly (no compiler coercion). Variadic printf/fprintf/snprintf forward to their v*-counterparts; terminalReadKey reads stdin headlessly.

libraries.name: ss_json
libraries.comment: APP-RUN-6 JSON document runtime (json.*): ss_json.c is a direct-return shim over the legacy native_json out-param API.

libraries.name: ss_bcrypt
libraries.comment: APP-RUN-6 password hashing + CSPRNG + base64url (bcrypt.*). R-028 routes randomness through native_platform/ss_platform_entropy.c. The app binds the native ss_bcrypt_*/ss_random_*/ss_base64url_* directly.

windows.comment: R-028: Windows CNG random bytes require bcrypt.dll; POSIX/macOS entropy backends use libc APIs here.

libraries.name: ss_log
libraries.comment: APP-RUN-6 structured logging (log.*). The app binds the native ss_log_* directly.

libraries.name: ss_net
libraries.comment: APP-RUN-1 HTTP-GET client (net.fetchText): a self-contained winsock GET, no legacy/third-party deps.

windows.comment: R-013: Winsock (ws2_32) is required for sockets on Windows only; POSIX hosts must NOT receive -lws2_32 or the link fails.

libraries.name: ss_async
libraries.comment: R-040 async runtime backed by libuv (third_party/libuv): the SemanticScript event-loop async runtime built with SEM_ASYNC_WITH_LIBUV, wrapped for the runtimeBinding seam. Single-threaded event loop, real libuv backend.

libraries.name: ss_gui
libraries.comment: WS3-044 GUI runtime: the SemanticScript Win32 GUI runtime wrapped for the runtimeBinding seam. A non-interactive health check (create window -> auto-close on shown -> return).
